presets.name: FLUX.2 Klein 4B reference edit
presets.description: Edits the supplied crop using a text instruction and image reference. The worker applies the original grayscale mask as output alpha after download. The diffusion model does not receive the mask; this is not native masked inpainting.
presets.input: sRGB PNG crop; mask is preserved locally for final alpha
presets.output: One RGB PNG restored to original crop dimensions; worker must apply mask as RGBA alpha
presets.source: API graph adapted from Comfy Org's official image_flux2_klein_image_edit_4b_distilled.json workflow template: https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/blob/main/templates/image_flux2_klein_image_edit_4b_distilled.json (MIT; see repository THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md).
